title: Week 12 risers and fallers in the MFPI
dek: The largest statewide rank moves this week, with the verified results and rating changes behind each one.
author: MFPI automated analysis

sources.label: MHSAA official score center (schedules and scores)
Statewide media rankings used for the Media Rank inputs

limitations: Movement is only shown against a comparable previous snapshot; teams without one are NEW.
Large moves in the middle of the table often reflect tightly bunched ratings rather than dramatic results.

sections.heading: How to read these moves
paragraphs: Rank movement is last week's statewide rank minus this week's. Rating change is this week's displayed MFPI minus last week's. They are separate facts: in the middle of the table, where ratings are close together, a small rating change can move a team many places, and a team can hold its place while its rating changes.
Both compare the Week 12 snapshot with the latest audited Week 11 snapshot (formula MFPI-3.2).

sections.heading: Biggest risers
paragraphs: [[choctaw-county]] (3A, 5-6): State ranking: up 12 spots to No. 44 (from No. 56). MFPI rating: increased 5.9 points to 75.3. In the window it beat [[edwards]] (currently No. 91) 42-8 on the road on Nov 13.

[[south-delta]] (1A, 8-3): State ranking: up 12 spots to No. 137 (from No. 149). MFPI rating: increased 2.3 points to 40.7. In the window it beat [[bogue-chitto]] (currently No. 199) 60-14 on the road on Nov 13.
[[west-jones]] (6A, 9-3): State ranking: up 11 spots to No. 40 (from No. 51). MFPI rating: increased 4.3 points to 75.7. In the window it beat [[gautier]] (currently No. 55) 42-12 at home on Nov 13.
[[simmons]] (1A, 9-1): State ranking: up 10 spots to No. 98 (from No. 108). MFPI rating: increased 3.3 points to 55.8. In the window it beat [[noxapater]] (currently No. 168) 38-0 at home on Nov 13.

[[northside]] (2A, 9-2): State ranking: up 10 spots to No. 108 (from No. 118). MFPI rating: increased 3.0 points to 52.5. In the window it beat [[myrtle]] (currently No. 127) 34-8 on the road on Nov 13.

[[cleveland-central]] (5A, 8-3): State ranking: up 7 spots to No. 43 (from No. 50). MFPI rating: increased 3.6 points to 75.4. In the window it beat [[pontotoc]] (currently No. 20) 22-16 on the road on Nov 13.

[[pearl]] (7A, 2-9): State ranking: up 7 spots to No. 58 (from No. 65). MFPI rating: increased 1.8 points to 69.0. It had no verified result in the window; the move comes from other teams' results and re-solved opponent ratings.

sections.heading: Biggest fallers
paragraphs: [[obannon]] (3A, 9-2): State ranking: down 13 spots to No. 150 (from No. 137). MFPI rating: decreased 2.7 points to 38.0. In the window it lost to [[aberdeen]] (currently No. 115) 12-32 on the road on Nov 13.

[[jefferson-davis-county]] (3A, 3-8): State ranking: down 8 spots to No. 122 (from No. 114). MFPI rating: decreased 3.8 points to 46.2. In the window it lost to [[franklin]] (currently No. 97) 27-61 at home on Nov 13.

[[columbia]] (4A, 7-5): State ranking: down 7 spots to No. 46 (from No. 39). MFPI rating: decreased 1.3 points to 74.4. In the window it lost to [[pass-christian]] (currently No. 39) 28-35 on the road on Nov 13.
[[stone]] (5A, 6-5): State ranking: down 7 spots to No. 82 (from No. 75). MFPI rating: decreased 2.8 points to 61.1. In the window it lost to [[laurel]] (currently No. 49) 27-42 at home on Nov 13.

[[myrtle]] (2A, 8-2): State ranking: down 7 spots to No. 127 (from No. 120). MFPI rating: decreased 2.1 points to 45.3. In the window it lost to [[northside]] (currently No. 108) 8-34 at home on Nov 13.

sections.heading: Rank and rating moving separately
paragraphs: Held their rank while the rating changed by at least a point: [[mount-olive]] (No. 220, -1.0).
Moved in the ranking with an unchanged displayed rating: [[picayune]] (-1 to No. 25); [[pass-christian]] (-1 to No. 39); [[jefferson-county]] (+1 to No. 164); [[taylorsville]] (+1 to No. 204).

sections.heading: Data notes and limitations
paragraphs: Snapshot generated November 17, 2026 at 11:12 AM Central with a cutoff of November 17 at 11:00 AM Central, formula MFPI-3.2.
1242 of 1265 game listings due by the cutoff had verified scores (98.2%); the rest count as unavailable, never as losses or 0-0 results.
[[wesson]] is credited with two games on Oct 23. One listing may belong to a same-named school; it is under review and affects that team and its opponents.
Opponent ranks in this article are the opponent's rank in this snapshot, not its rank on the day the game was played, unless a sentence says otherwise.
